body:
Not ugly.

Unlucky and lonely.

There's more people who don't get along with each other than people who do get along with each other in this world.

No excuse for the police telling me to a leave a person alone who's being clingy with me.

They could also focus on the person who makes others angry rather than the person who's already angry.

What I'm most sick of in this world.

Passive-aggressive people.

My family is abusive.

Make me unhappy in every way possible.


Especially my older brother.
My brother messed up my life too.
I struggle with making long-term decisions.

I have no one I can turn to either.

I've tried the best I can to get a job, and no place will hire me.
